where: verify/bs-catalog.js points / composition / options
why: Two errors in the BSData-only points column. (1) verify/bs-catalog.js:220 sums each model entry’s own min; Vertus Praetors’ model entry is min 0 inside the group “2-3 Vertus Praetors” (groupMin 2), so lo = 0 → 1 and the tiers read “1 model 220, 3 models 330” (GW: 2 models 220, 3 models 330). (2) line 218 writes every instanceOf+before modifier as “each earlier copy of this datasheet”, dropping the localConditionGroup’s threshold: Venatari (both) are `atLeast 2` earlier copies, i.e. GW’s “YOUR 1ST TO 2ND UNITS COST 255 / YOUR 3RD+ 280”, but read as +25 from the 2nd. Tested fix (1): only Vertus Praetors changes, to [{models:2,pts:220},{models:3,pts:330}]. Also note: Prosecutors/Vigilators/Witchseekers tiers say 6 models 80/90/100 where GW prices 9 (BSData’s atLeast 6); and the column is nowhere compared with GW’s costs.
fix: verify/bs-catalog.js:220 `const comp = composition(root), grp = new Map(comp.filter(c => c.group && c.groupMin != null).map(c => [c.group, c.groupMin])), lo = (comp.filter(c => !grp.has(c.group)).reduce((t, c) => t + (c.min || 0), 0) + [...grp.values()].reduce((t, v) => t + v, 0)) || 1, hi = …` (rest unchanged); verify/bs-catalog.js:218 the when of an instanceOf+before modifier names its group’s count: `when: … ? (g && g.value > 1 ? 'each copy after the first ' + g.value + ' of this datasheet in the army' : 'each earlier copy of this datasheet in the army') : …` with g the localConditionGroup (type atLeast, value) the conditions came from; then from-bsdata.js --write.
